sources.excerpt: MZ-2 Digital Metalizer Published on July 12, 2005 Boss compact pedals chorus distortion lfo-controlled pedal Information The Boss MZ-2 Digital Metalizer is a distortion pedal produced in Japan between 1987 and 1992. It combines an analog distortion circuit with digital chorus and delay processing, making it one of the most unusual designs in the classic Boss lineup. The pedal delivers saturated distortion tones on their own or blended with spatial effects, creating a sound that became associated with the late 1980s heavy metal aesthetic. The MZ-2 features six selectable modes: straight distortion, three distortion plus delay modes, and two distortion plus chorus modes. The delay modes function as doubling effects, while the chorus settings provide wide, modulated textures. With stereo outputs, the pedal produces expansive, spatially enhanced distortion tones not typically found in compact pedals of its era. Controls Level : sets overall output volume Tone : adjusts EQ brightness and character Drive : controls the amount of distortion gain Mode switch : six-way rotary selector for distortion, chorus, and doubling modes Connections 1 x 1/4" input 2 x 1/4" outputs (A and B for stereo operation) 9V DC power input or 9V battery operation Technical Specifications Current draw: 70 mA (DC 9V) Input impedance: 1 MOhm Equivalent input noise: -120 dBm (IHF-A) Recommended load impedance: 10 kOhm or greater Dimensions: standard Boss compact pedal format Weight: approx. 450 g (0.99 lbs) Recommended power supply: Boss PSA series Made in Japan (blue label) Highlights Combination of analog distortion and digital modulation effects Six selectable modes including distortion, chorus, and doubling delays Stereo outputs for spacious and immersive tones Suitable for metal, industrial, and experimental sounds Produced in Japan from 1987 to 1992 and now a collectible model Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2026-08-09 Leon Todd BOSS MZ2 Digital Metalizer || Great or Garbage? 11:18 2026-07-05 Leon Todd BOSS Digital Metalizer MZ-2...Not Very Metal But It Sounds Great! #davidgilmour #pinkfloyd #guitar 1:21 2026-02-06 Jason Ayala Spare Boss Metal Pedals (HM-2, MZ-2, MT-2, HM-3, ML

It offers six modes, including standard distortion, distortion with digital delay, and distortion with digital chorus. Featuring an analog distortion circuit combined with digital chorus and delay, the MZ-2 provides stereo outputs and controls for Level, Tone, Drive, and Mode selection.
